question_or_proposition: For Daphnia pulex whole effluent toxicity (48-hr acute static-renewal NOEC), does the Part I WET table row showing value 'Report' and measurement frequency 'Once/Quarter', read together with footnote *9, establish only a Part I monitoring-and-reporting obligation without a numeric effluent limit for compliance comparison, or must numeric pass/fail criteria and/or conditional monitoring applicability (including any frequency reduction) be determined from PART II Whole Effluent Toxicity testing requirements?
required_context: PART II Whole Effluent Toxicity testing requirements referenced in footnote *9
Permit effective date for determining when WET monitoring requirements begin
source_locator: farmington/final_permit.pdf, Page 5, Section part_i, WET table row Daphnia pulex; footnote *9
notes: The nominated row assigns 'Report' rather than a numeric limit and footnote *9 cross-references PART II for additional WET conditions and a frequency-reduction option. How Part I and Part II provisions are read together affects whether numeric limit comparisons apply (Purpose A), whether quarterly monitoring was required during FY2025 (Purpose B), and how absent WET results should be classified (Purpose C).
